notes.title: Big Gamepad Changes

[h2]MANUAL FIRE COMPARISON[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/e783e00c28685bd828dbfa0819c69d99f8edb737.png[/img]

[h3]GENERAL FIXES AND CHANGES[/h3]


[list]
[*] [b]FIXED |[/b] An audio bug would occur near save stations with boom boxes that would cause the sound to crackle.
[*] [b]FIXED |[/b] Gamepad's inputs would be ignored if it was not detected as player 1. Now, whatever gamepad is touched last becomes the primary controller.
[*] [b]ADDED |[/b] VFX were added to player bullets to better indicate the visual distance they travel. 
[*] [b]ADJUSTMENTS |[/b] Changes to Gamepad controls for a better player experience. Mini-Map is changed for both M&K and Gamepad.
[*] [b]ADJUSTMENTS |[/b] Tablet System overhauled for Gamepad.
[*] [b]ADJUSTMENTS |[/b] Player Invulnerability Window decreased from 1.2 sec --> 1 sec
[*] [b]ADJUSTMENTS |[/b] Repulsor Ability has been buffed.
[olist]
[*] Repulsor Bullet now destroys energy bullets it comes in contact with.
[/olist]
[*] [b]MISC |[/b] Other adjustments, changes and fixes.
[/list]

[h3]CHIP ADJUSTMENTS[/h3]

[b]Worm Hole Chip[/b] has received a buff. 
[olist]
[*] Bonus Health, Atomic Energy, and overheat cool-down occurs when taking the worm hole.
[/olist]
[b]Glob Drive Chip[/b] has been given a new debuff mechanic to make its use more risk reward oriented.
[olist]
[*] Every consecutive heal will put Bek in a vulnerable state for 1.5 sec (stacked). While in this state Bek receives double the intended damage. That means double damage attacks now do quadruple damage.  Be careful when using it!
[/olist]
[b]Fusion Chip[/b] has received a buff.
[olist]
[*] Dispatching enemies has a chance of spawning an enzyme.
[/olist]

[h3]GUN MOD ADJUSTMENTS[/h3]

[b]Master Blaster[/b]
[olist]
[*] Damage has been decreased from (*20 per hit --> 12 per hit*).
[/olist]
[b]Default Blaster[/b]
[olist]
[*] Range has seen a minor increase. 
[/olist]
[b]Shredder[/b]
[olist]
[*]Damage has increased from (*4 per hit* --> *8 per hit*). This increases its potential damage from (*8 --> 16*).
[*] Range has seen a minor increase.
[/olist]
[b]Expulsion[/b] 
[olist]
[*]Damage has decreased from (*15 per hit* --> *12 per hit*).
[/olist]

notes.title: Holiday Update
notes.content:
[h1]Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays everyone![/h1]

We’ve got a small surprise for you all. Alongside working hard on the next big content update for BioGun, set to launch in January, we’ve prepared a little something special for Christmas! :santa::gift:

Here’s what’s new:

[h3][u][b]Cheat System[/b][/u][/h3]
We’ve added a cheat system to make the game more accessible for everyone! You can activate these cheats via the pause menu. However, please note:

[b]Enabling cheats will  disable Steam Achievements for that save file, even if you turn the cheats off later.[/b]

[h3][u][b]Performance Optimization[/b][/u][/h3]
We’ve been working on optimizing the game to improve performance. While we haven’t been able to test it on a wide scale yet, we’ve observed a notable boost on our devices. According to our data, we've cut the games memory in half since Early Access launch with this update! 

[h3][u][b]New Achievements[/b][/u][/h3]
We've added a few more early game achievements to balance out the rate at which you get them. Considering many players first achievement was defeating Roo Caper :Angry_RooCaper: Loading into your file may net you some of them immediately! 

If you’ve experienced performance issues before, we’d love for you to give the game another shot and let us know if these improvements make a difference.


[h3][u][b]Final Thoughts:[/b][/u][/h3]
2024 was a huge year for us and we are grateful to have fostered such an awesome community around BioGun. We thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy this little festive treat! 

Signing off for the year!

Happy Holidays!
~ The BioGun Team

[u][h3][b]For those affected by a black screen when loading into your save file...[/b][/h3][/u]
[i]NOT to be confused with getting a black screen when transitioning between rooms in the game. That is a seperate issue related to storage space on your device.[/i]


I created a beta branch that gives access the the build of BioGun before v1.5 update. To access it, right click BioGun on Steam in your library, go to properties and then select Beta.

Enter the password: BioGunPreVersion

Once you do so, select the drop-down box that says none and select the beta you now have access to.

[b]BEWARE.[/b] I won’t be able to fix the black screen issue so you will be stuck in this version if you want to keep playing your save file. I highly recommend starting a new file in the latest version if you want to receive future updates. I apologize for this inconvenience. I didn't anticipate issues with some save files and we didn't run into this with our playtesters before pushing the update.

notes.title: A Tale of Community Growth and Development Triumphs
notes.content:
[b]Hello fans of Bek, and defenders of canines worldwide![/b]

BioGun has just completed an amazing month, first completing a highly successful closed beta, and then, as part of the SHMUP fest, the open demo. The response that we've received has left everyone in the team overjoyed at the heartwarming response from the ever-growing community.

So, what have we learned from the game sessions, and what do we think of everything? Read on to find out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/4f9bf0d7e50c35df932d6f597f6cec37a632f4f3.png[/img]

Witnessing the community expand and passionately engage in discussions about BioGun's development was a source of immense joy for the entire team. The enthusiasm from players provided a boost of motivation, and everyone involved cherished the opportunity to connect with gamers who shared their excitement for the project.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/6b06d63dbee52cb0bb01b7a33ea9156a7e9a5eb3.png[/img]

While we were always confident in the fun factor of BioGun, we were still amazed at the surge of excitement from everyone from our existing community members and the new people, those who discovered BioGun as part of the closed-beta and open demo campaigns. Frankly, the level of enthusiasm displayed has further fuelled our commitment to delivering a game that will meet and exceed everyone's expectations.

On the topic of the community, we want to thank everyone who not only took part in the playtests, but who also invested a huge amount of their own time to help us further improve BioGun with their extremely detailed feedback and bug reports. What's more, we were blown away by the community's resilience in the face of game bugs. We've seen many fantastic games turn sour due to bugs, however, despite encountering issues, testers continued to find joy in the game, underscoring the intrinsic appeal and potential of BioGun. Thanks to all of this, we were able to not only work on polishing the game but also hugely enjoy ourselves the entire time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/dddd811874b6836430270031609f76d8fb8ed1eb.gif[/img]

At this point, we want to give a very special shout-out to MegaMaster89, and Gleepot. 
When the closed beta started, we were not able to verify the game's performance on the Steam Deck as our main focus was on the PC version. Therefore, while we had hoped that the game would work on the Steam Deck, we knew that there would be issues. But then the Biogun Community Stepped up and took things into their own hands! A few of our members were able to get the game running on the Steam Deck, took notes of the bugs and issues that they encountered, and even jumped into voice chats with our team to help them (our team) properly understand and identify the issues. 

The result of this? We were able to work on special fixes, optimizing BioGun for the Steam Deck!

A particularly delightful highlight was the reception to the "Critical Blaster chip." It was this item that led to a truly fantastic video, curtsy of lightning47 on our Discord server. Using this item, he was able to take on every boss in the demo, without taking a single hit! Want to see how he did it? Check it out here.

[previewyoutube=KdAXFxY5GSE;full][/previewyoutube]

This brings us to the end of this brief update. If you take anything from this article, it’s that we are eternally grateful to the community for everything that they’ve done! We’ll be back soon with more BioGun news, so make sure to stay tuned.

notes.title: Dev Diary #1 | Inside the organism
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 
It's [b]John[/b] and [b]Ivan[/b], the developers of [b]BioGun[/b]. 

Development has been going well and we’re really enjoying how our game is shaping up. Though to be honest, we're not big fans of sharing ongoing progress, because we want you guys to discover the world of [b]BioGun[/b] for yourselves! With that said, we are very excited to provide an inside look at what we’ve been working on. So, in celebration of our appearance in PCGamer's livestream, we decided now is a good time to give you a quick glimpse into what's coming to [b]BioGun[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/4f9bf0d7e50c35df932d6f597f6cec37a632f4f3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/03037bd9eab9d5bab99c3ae6a6b491151da901cb.png[/img]

Isn’t it kinda cute?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/cf09f51849f5a0c0778221448ec1b7418cd34f61.gif[/img]

Unfortunately, he doesn’t like it when you get too close and will make you second guess your approach…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/3fd61bf7d546dbf49150e25fbe5ec3a782ad578c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/4f9bf0d7e50c35df932d6f597f6cec37a632f4f3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/b86c664236c49c38fa48bf700bda214a09f8da65.png[/img]

Luckily, with the right weaponry, you can snipe him from a safe distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/559ea4bcaf090bf447dca7c7e07f515cd1394c99.gif[/img]

Even multiple of them! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/b67ef07d9f18cc049920d1c50f1f0b71dc647400.gif[/img]

[b]The VIRAL RIFLE[/b] is a fantastically powerful weapon that allows you to hit enemies from a distance. It also travels through walls and multiple enemies. We’ve been having a lot of fun using it and can’t wait until you try it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/4f9bf0d7e50c35df932d6f597f6cec37a632f4f3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/f63ea6f98a03036683dc041d79a8452043b289a0.png[/img]

Do you remember [b]Phoebe[/b]? 
Well, she has two sisters! One of them is hard at work, but ready to reveal herself. Introducing: [b]Piper[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/c91c12ddad8ba28fd5dba5fb0213045ffa9ed335.gif[/img]

[b]Piper[/b] is way more adept with her hands than her mind. While [b]Phoebe[/b] creates the schematics, [b]Piper[/b] is the one that gets to build them.  If you enjoy your [b]Atomic Baths[/b], be sure to thank her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/4f9bf0d7e50c35df932d6f597f6cec37a632f4f3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/aff38d22f2d6a903d20f37c866671ce7c49e479c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/5ae9edff975329a0c334689293e31d438be35f25.gif[/img]

What mysteries lie hidden within the thick bog of the Pancreas…

Last but not least have you ever wondered what happens when the [b]Dooper virus[/b] completely overtakes an organ?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/87d0df539eba02043b0cfd98435c228769835da1.gif[/img]

Don't let this fate befall the remaining organs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004894/4f9bf0d7e50c35df932d6f597f6cec37a632f4f3.png[/img]

So far, developing [b]BioGun[/b] is turning out to be one of the most fulfilling experiences of our lives. We can’t wait until you guys experience what we have in store for you. Until then, thank you for your patience and keep looking forward to updates as we make the game we always wanted to play - [b]BioGun[/b].
